system.description: Battery operated remote controlled drone. Requires two hands to operate receiver. Can fly up to 450m high, to a distance of 3km from operator. Can run for 2 hours. Can record and transmit footage to receiver. If purchased separately, can be equipped with up to two of the following: binoculars, radio jammer, Geiger counter, laser cutter, medscanner, personal locator, infrared goggles, emergency beacon, cybernetic diagnostic scanner, bioscanner. Can carry up to 20-30kg.
